articles.headline: How the auto industry is trying to make software-defined vehicles last
articles.summary: Software-defined vehicles offer advantages their analog rivals can‘t compete with. But the hardware and software in them needs to be maintained, and some owners have found their cars suddenly obsolete or without key features. CNBC talked with industry figures, including Rivian Chief Software Officer Wassym Bensaid about the promise of software-defined vehicles and how his company is trying to handle the challenges this new form of ownership poses.

articles.headline: Why American brands are losing relevance in China
articles.summary: Chinese consumers are turning away from American brands, from fashion to technology to cars. Experts say many companies have lost cultural relevance there, while domestic brands have innovated. Many shoppers also don’t think American prices are worth it, and geopolitical tensions have only increased shoppers’ willingness to buy from China. CNBC’s Laya Neelakandan has more on this growing trend.
